note: What each website check means and the usual fix, for the one-page audit. Plain advice, no statistics. Checks come from packs/_kit/leads.js (gap ids).

site_down.matters: People who tap your link see an error and may think you closed.
site_down.fix: Check your hosting and domain renewal, then open the site on your phone to confirm it loads.

parked.matters: A placeholder page makes visitors wonder if you're open.
parked.fix: Publish a simple homepage, or point the domain to your booking page until it's ready.

no_https.matters: Chrome marks sites without https as Not secure, which puts visitors off.
no_https.fix: Turn on the free SSL certificate in your hosting or website builder.

no_mobile.matters: Many visitors see your site on a phone, where this one shows up tiny.
no_mobile.fix: Add a viewport tag or switch to a mobile-ready theme.

no_tap_to_call.matters: On a phone, a number that isn't a link has to be copied by hand.
no_tap_to_call.fix: Make the phone number in your header a tap-to-call (tel:) link.

no_booking.matters: Some customers would rather book than call, especially after hours.
no_booking.fix: Add a Book now button that opens a booking page.

no_form.matters: Some visitors won't call. A form gives them another way in.
no_form.fix: Add a short form: name, phone or email, and what they need.

no_email.matters: People who prefer to write have no way to reach you.
no_email.fix: Add an email address or a contact form.

no_hours.matters: People check hours before they visit or call.
no_hours.fix: List your hours on the homepage and in the footer.

no_prices.matters: Without any prices, visitors have to ask before they know if you fit.
no_prices.fix: Show starting prices (from $X) for your main services.

no_offer.matters: A clear first-visit offer is a reason for someone new to pick you now.
no_offer.fix: Add one simple offer for first-time customers near the top.

no_reviews_shown.matters: Visitors look for proof that others had a good experience.
no_reviews_shown.fix: Show 3 real reviews on the homepage (with permission) or link to your reviews.

few_images.matters: Photos show people what to expect before they come in.
few_images.fix: Add 6 to 10 recent photos of your work, space and team.

no_video.matters: A short video shows what a visit is like faster than text.
no_video.fix: Add one 15 to 30 second vertical video near the top of the homepage.

no_instagram.matters: Customers often check recent posts before they visit.
no_instagram.fix: Link your Instagram in the header or footer.

no_social.matters: Visitors look for recent posts to see if a business is active.
no_social.fix: Link your social accounts in the footer.

no_signup.matters: Past customers are the easiest to bring back, but only if you can reach them.
no_signup.fix: Add an email signup with one reason to join.

no_description.matters: Without one, Google picks random text to show under your name.
no_description.fix: Write a 150-character description of what you do and where.

no_h1.matters: The H1 tells Google and visitors what the page is about.
no_h1.fix: Make your main headline an H1 that says what you do and where.

no_schema.matters: Structured data helps Google read your name, hours and location.
no_schema.fix: Add LocalBusiness schema with your name, address, phone and hours.

missing_alt.matters: Alt text helps Google read your photos and helps people using screen readers.
missing_alt.fix: Add a short description to each photo.

thin_site.matters: With little text, Google has little to match to searches.
thin_site.fix: Add a short section for each service and the areas you serve.

stale_footer.matters: An old year in the footer makes the site look unattended.
stale_footer.fix: Update the footer year, or set it to update itself.

no_analytics.matters: Without analytics you can't see how many people visit or where they come from.
no_analytics.fix: Turn on Google Analytics or your builder's own analytics.

no_pixel.matters: Without one, ads can't reach people who already visited.
no_pixel.fix: Add the free Meta pixel through your website builder's settings.

no_chat.matters: Questions that come in after hours wait until the next day.
no_chat.fix: Add a chat button or a short question form that goes to your phone.

no_map.matters: A map helps people see you're nearby and find you.
no_map.fix: Embed a map on the contact page or homepage.
